name: ehs-human-factors-ontology: a machine-readable performance-influencing-factor ontology
description: A machine-readable encoding of the four-context performance-influencing-factor structure used in human reliability analysis, with alignments to SPAR-H, CREAM, HFACS and the HSE PIF list, and a rule engine for scenario assessment. The four context dimensions are not new; they are adopted from IDHEAS-G (NUREG-2198, 2021). Python 3.9+, standard library only.
